title: CIL Mode Switch Rollback Requirements
description: Portable rollback REQUIREMENTS. Concrete per-surface locations and identities are install-time state produced by Q4, never package truth. A TEMPLATE carries placeholder locations and no identities. A RESOLVED document is authoritative for exactly one install and pins, for every surface, a durable identity for the candidate payload it installs AND for the prior known-good payload or state it would restore. A location alone is not an identity: a path can be rewritten, and a path to an uncommitted local file is not recoverable.

installId.description: The install this document resolves, equal to the installId of that install's INSTALL-PIN.json. Null in a template; required in a RESOLVED document, so a resolved rollback plan cannot float free of the install it claims to cover.

candidateIdentity.description: Durable identity of the payload this install writes to the surface. Null in a template. In a RESOLVED document it is sha256:<64 hex> or git:<40 hex>.

priorIdentity.description: Durable identity of the prior known-good payload or state this surface is restored to. Null in a template. In a RESOLVED document it is sha256:<64 hex>, git:<40 hex>, or absent:<REASON> where the surface genuinely held no prior payload and rollback is removal.
